definition: a person who cuts and sells meat
description: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.
